REPORT

Subject (in full) Arrest of Lee S u-chi (李维基) on charge of propagating
communism, and his extradition.

Made by D.S.I.Montgomery Forwarded by Henry Robertson C.P.I.

at 6.45 a.m. on May 1, 1931, acting on the authority of
warrant No.21-1, issued at the request of the Shanghai-Moosung
Military Headquarters, by the Shanghai Special District Court,
for the arrest of one Wong I'h Bai (王益培), on charge of
being the chairman of the Hunan Soviet communists, supposed to
be residing in the upstairs front room of 493 Nanking Road, I,
together with detectives from Bubbling Well Station and two
representatives of the Shanghai and Moosung Military Headquarters,
visited premises in question and in the front upstairs room found
a quantity of communistic literature in Russian and Japanese.
The occupant of the room, one Lee Liu-chi, on being
questioned, stated that the books belonged to one named Wong
Tiong S (江昌绪) who had gone to Szechuan. Lee stated that
his occupation was that of a translator and was at that time
engaged in translating Japanese books dealing with economical
and political problems, into Chinese. He admitted, however, that
he was in Changsha during the Communist occupation of that city.
He denied knowing Wong I'h Bai.
Lee Szu-chi was accordingly arrested and charged under
Art.2 Section 2 of the Laws Governing the Punishment of Persons who
Commit Acts with Intent to Injure the Republic of China, and
appeared before the Shanghai Special District Court on May 2,
1931 when an application was made by the Chinese authorities
for his handing over. The case was remanded until the afternoon
of May 4, 1931 when the application was again made and granted.
The Procurator observed that if the accused was not Wong I'h Bai
(the person mentioned on the warrant), he should not be
extradited.

报告

主题（全称） 李维基（Lee S u-chi）因散布共产主义罪名被捕及其引渡事宜。

由特别调查员蒙哥马利（D.S.I. Montgomery）撰写，经警务处主任督察亨利·罗伯逊（Henry Robertson C.P.I.）转呈。

1931年5月1日上午6时45分，依据上海特区地方法院应淞沪警备司令部之请求签发的第21-1号逮捕令，逮捕涉嫌担任湖南苏维埃共产党主席的王益培（Wong I'h Bai），据信其居住于南京路493号楼上前间。本人会同静安寺巡捕房的侦探以及淞沪警备司令部的两名代表，前往上述处所，并在楼上前间发现大量俄文和日文的共产主义文献。
该房间住客李留基（Lee Liu-chi）在接受讯问时称，这些书籍属于一名叫江昌绪（Wong Tiong S）的人，此人已前往四川。李氏称其职业为翻译，当时正从事将有关经济和政治问题的日文书籍翻译成中文的工作。然而，他承认在共产党占领长沙期间曾身在长沙。他否认认识王益培。
因此，李嗣基（Lee Szu-chi）被捕，并被指控违反《危害民国紧急治罪法》第二条第二款，于1931年5月2日出庭上海特区地方法院，当时中国当局申请将其移交。案件延期至1931年5月4日下午，再次提出并获准移交申请。
检察官指出，如果被告并非王益培（逮捕令上提及之人），则不应将其引渡。
法院命令将被告的个人财产

(14) Theory and Practice of the Marxism. By J.K.Bammel. (according to Lenin)

Page 327-328 Chapter IV.
Modern Society is built up on the exploitation of great masses of working people by a small minority of the population belonging to the class of landowners and capitalists.
This Society is a Society of slave-owners, because "free" workers toiling all their lives long for the Capitalists "have right" of having only such means of livelihood which are necessary for keeping them alive for producing profits, for making possible further existence of Capitalistic slavery.
The economic oppression of the labourers inevitably brings about all kinds of political oppression, social humiliation and obscurity of spiritual and moral life of masses.
Labourers can succeed in obtaining a certain degree of political freedom for themselves, but no freedom will relieve them of poverty, unemployment and oppression until the power of the Capitalism will be overthrown................
But a slave who is conscious of his slavery and is ready to fight for freedom already ceases by half to be a slave.
Modern class conscious worker, trained by working in heavy industry and educated by the modern city life, dispassionately throws away all religious superstitions, leaves the heaven for priests and bourgeois bigots and fights for better life for himself on the earth. The modern worker is for the Socialism which uses signs in its struggle against religion and frees the worker from believing the future life by organising workers for the struggle for better life on the earth.

(26) On the Philosophical front after October. By J.Bammel.

Page 7 Chapter I.
Our doctrine is not a dogma, but a guide for action - as Marx, Engels and Lenin used to say. By this, they stressed on the fact that Marxism is not a theory applicable to all cases, made once and forever, and therefore a dead theory.
The Marxism grew out of experience of great labour movement according to its conception by the vanguard of the proletariat as a theory of the Proletarian struggle.
As a guide for action Marxism grows, becomes stronger, develops and is corrected in the revolution of the Class Struggle, on the soil of growing labour movement, on the soil of the growing crisis of the Capitalism.
The Marxism grows in the practice of the Class-struggle and in the same time organizes the practice of the Proletarian struggle.
Our theory is not a dogma but a guide for action; to forget this - said Lenin - is to make Marxism in one sided, deformed and dead, because by doing so we take the soul out of it, its foundation.

第327-328页 第四章。
现代社会是建立在占人口少数的地主和资本家阶级对广大劳动群众的剥削之上的。
这个社会是一个奴隶主社会，因为“自由”工人终身为资本家劳作，却只“有权”获得维持其生存所必需的生活资料，以便为资本家创造利润，使资本主义奴役得以继续存在。
对劳动者的经济压迫不可避免地带来各种政治压迫、社会屈辱以及群众精神道德生活的晦暗。
劳动者或许能为自己争取到一定程度的政治自由，但在资本主义权力被推翻之前，任何自由都无法使他们摆脱贫困、失业和压迫................
但是，一个意识到自己的奴隶地位并准备为自由而战的奴隶，就已经有一半不再是奴隶了。
现代具有阶级意识的工人，在重工业工作中经受锻炼，在现代城市生活中接受教育，冷静地抛弃一切宗教迷信，将天堂留给牧师和资产阶级偏执狂，并为自己在地球上争取更美好的生活而战斗。现代工人拥护社会主义，社会主义在其反对宗教的斗争中运用科学手段，并通过组织工人为地球上的美好生活而斗争，使工人不再相信来世。

(26) 《十月革命后的哲学战线》。作者：J. Bammel。

第7页 第一章。
我们的学说不是教条，而是行动的指南——正如马克思、恩格斯和列宁常说的那样。借此，他们强调这样一个事实：马克思主义并非一种适用于所有情况、一劳永逸制定出来的理论，因此也不是一种僵死的理论。
马克思主义是根据无产阶级先锋队将其作为无产阶级斗争理论的概念，从伟大的工人运动经验中生长出来的。
作为行动指南，马克思主义在阶级斗争的革命中，在日益发展的工人运动的土壤上，在资本主义危机日益加深的土壤上，不断成长、壮大、发展并得到修正。
马克思主义在阶级斗争的实践中成长，同时也组织无产阶级斗争的实践。
我们的理论不是教条，而是行动的指南；列宁说，忘记这一点，就会使马克思主义变得片面、畸形和僵死，因为这样做我们就抽去了它的灵魂，即它的基础。

My name is Lee San Chi, age 23, native of Hunan. I am a
translator of Japanese Literature. I began school at the age of

I came to Shanghai. I studied at the Shanghai College, Ching Yuen
Road Chapel. I was at this school for six months and then went
home for the summer vacation. Owing the trouble and fighting at
Wuchong(1926) I was unable to return, so I got obtained a post at
the Pao Ching Middle School as a teacher. I has this job for six
months but as I wanted to continue my studies I resigned and
obtained a situation as editor of the "Daily Republican" at Chang-
sha. After three months the Communists took Changsha and
prohibited the sale of the newspaper. I then got a situation as
a teacher in the Wo Yoong School at the Wo Yoong Hsien, Hunan.

the school was closed, and I returned to my native place at
Changsha. I took ill during the Autumn of 1927 and was unemployed

studied at the Kiangsu University for one month but was unsatisfied

where I studied International Literature in Japanese. In June

at the college. I then obtained a situation as editor of the

为了执行上海淞沪警备司令部提请上海特区法院签发的针对王伊白（Wong I Bae）（        ）的逮捕令，指控其为共产主义者，市政警察于5月1日上午在安南路93A号进行逮捕行动时，拘捕了李祖基（Li Zau-kyi）（        ），在其房间内查获了大量俄文和日文的共产主义书籍。他将于1931年5月2日出庭受审。

    Li Zan-kyi (        ), who was arrested on May 1,

literature in Japanese and Russian was found, appeared
before the Shanghai Special District Court on May 4, 1931,
on remand, when an application made by a representative

extradition was granted.
